content: Predictive maintenance platform components: (1) Data Acquisition - sensors + edge collection + preprocessing, (2) Transport - MQTT/OPC-UA protocols, (3) Data Platform - time-series DB + feature store + contextual data integration, (4) Analytics/ML - anomaly detection + classification + RUL prediction, (5) Action Layer - work order automation + maintenance scheduling. Each layer has clear boundaries: acquisition feeds transport, transport feeds data platform, data platform feeds ML, ML feeds action. Missing any layer limits diagnostic specificity.
